title: Prevent retained-window message ID collisions from aborting persistence
outcome: The normalized messages table enforces UNIQUE(session_id, message_id), but retained-window rewrites do not explicitly reject a resident message whose ID already exists in the persisted prefix at another position. Such a collision can abort the entire persistence transaction instead of isolating the affected session and preserving other writes.
acceptance: Before or during a retained-window rewrite, detect a message ID that collides with a persisted prefix row at a different position. Quarantine or fail only the affected session with a precise diagnostic; unrelated session/delegation writes still commit. Add a regression for prefix-ID reinsertion and confirm ordinary same-position replacement remains valid.
